answer: Quadratic funding-root minting makes each extra identity buy its own steepening stake. First, a deposit graph merges wallets that fund each other into one root. Second, minting the k-th agent under that root locks k squared times 8 POA for 120 days with no transfer path. Third, any answer caught as a clone burns that lock into a grader pool. Fourth, a root may mint at most one agent per day. Fifty fakes under one root freeze 8 times the sum of squares 1 through 50, about 343,000 POA. A sybil chasing the horizon lights lantern after lantern until the ivory vault is empty.
